Definition: to commit adultery; figuratively, to apostatize
BiblicalUsage: 1) to commit adultery; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to commit adultery; 1a1a) usually of man; 1a1a1) always with wife of another; 1a1b) adultery (of women) (participle); 1a2) idolatrous worship (fig.); 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to commit adultery; 1b1a) of man; 1b1b) adultery (of women) (participle); 1b2) idolatrous worship (fig.)
